description: CatBoost agent-tune of the #1 date-aligned cell (russell1000 +50%/200d/dd25%) vs its CatBoost sweep, after resnapping the stale _266-failed #1 bar on the current vintage. _269 follow-up. Date-aligned, test window 2023-07-27..2024-10-03 (test_end 2024-10-03).
metric: R-Precision@K (per-day fixed K, macro over days R_q>0, min(K,R_q) denominator)

bar_was_stale.note: The #1 sweep failed _266's inference faithfulness self-check (max_abs_diff 0.165). Resnapped on current vintage for a fair bar.
bar_was_stale.conclusion: Resnap reproduces the stale bar to the decimal -> the _266 failure was a reproduction-PATH artifact (infer_fresh feature-build path), NOT performance drift. The #1 bar is trustworthy. Same as the _268 resnaps.

verdict: Marginal mixed win: CatBoost-agent edges the (verified) #1 sweep at 4/5 K (@1/@5/@10/@20) but LOSES @3 (-0.055), the board's headline metric. Beats both XGBoost agents at @1/@3 (best agent variant), but cannot clear the cheap CatBoost sweep at @3. Not the sp500/50-style breakout. The CatBoost sweep remains the #1-cell default; do NOT promote the cbagent.
finding: Three agent-tunes (2x XGBoost, 1x CatBoost) have all failed to beat the ≤3-iter CatBoost sweep at @3 on the #1 cell. The sweep's un-FS'd, un-subsampled defaults hold the @2-@3 band better; the cbagent's FS-prefit (53 of 279 feats) + subsample gained @1 and the broad tail but gave up @3. Eval->test decay -0.157 @1 is the _269 long-horizon disease.
followups: #26 investigate the @3 regression (chiefly FS-prefit) vs the verified bar
